title: World Of Warcraft Is Getting A Fantastic New Transmog Option Soon
content: Anyone who plays World of Warcraft knows the real endgame is looking cool , and Blizzard is giving players another way to do just that with a new transmog feature coming in patch 12.0.5. As revealed in the latest 12.0.5 public test realm development notes , players will soon be able to choose how to sheath their one handed weapons using the game's transmog system.
